label: prf:graded-hecke-energy-truncation-bound
title: Proof of graded hecke energy truncation bound
html:
Proof

By graded Markov trace existence, the trace \mathrm{tr}_M descends to a sequence of functionals \mathrm{tr}_{M, \ell} \colon J^\ell(q) / J^{\ell+1}(q) \to \mathbb{R} along the GS confinement filtration J^\bullet(q). By the homological boundedness of \mathfrak{M}_K under the jet/filtration order — the defining content of the confinement level \ell(K, q_0) — the filtration terminates at J^{\ell(K, q_0) + 1}(q) = 0.

Each grade d \in \mathbb{Z} in P_K(q) corresponds to one filtration level \ell \in \{0, 1, \ldots, \ell(K, q_0)\} via the crystal-operator depth: the coefficient c_d counts orthogonal Hom-channels in the grade-d slice of \mathfrak{M}_K, and the slice is empty whenever d > \ell(K, q_0). Hence at most \ell(K, q_0) + 1 grades carry nonzero coefficients. \square
